purpose: LC-08 reuse audit; thresholds copied unchanged from historical pre-collection freeze; common-three support is a new descriptive diagnostic, not a newly trained acceptance rule
split: rolling one-step-ahead current bearing excluded before prediction; it may be consumed after prediction and become history for later frames
group_selection: existing mature, normal, recovery, startup labels; no outcome-selected group
common_support: same source ID (epoch, core ID, feature ID, entered time, camera, timestamp); require all three original predictors valid and live past anchor
interpretation: prediction advantage is neither independent information rank nor fusion trajectory benefit; shared-history information and main visual consumption provenance remain dependencies
